title: Cash Pickup Payout Points on Mobile Wallet Shortfall Re-Credits
content:
Cross-product benefit schedule: a customer's **Cash Pickup** payouts earn points on a **Mobile Wallet** shortfall re-credit.

**Rule.** The Cash Pickup points of a shortfall re-credit follow the customer's Cash Pickup payouts made in the last 12 calendar months, that is the number of their Cash Pickup payout-made entries in that window:

| Cash Pickup payouts made in the window | Cash Pickup points |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 0.20 |
| at least 2 and fewer than 4 | 0.10 |
| fewer than 2 | nothing |

**The window.** It is rolling: it holds the entries whose entry date lies fewer than 12 whole calendar months before today, the whole calendar months from a date to today being the difference between the two calendar months, less one when today's day of the month is lower than that date's.

## Hypothetical cases (today 2026-10-04)
- Payouts made on 2025-10-05, 2026-01-20 and 2026-06-02: all three are inside the window (the first gives 11 whole months), so 3 payouts and 0.10 points.
- A payout made on 2025-10-04 gives 12 whole months and is outside the window.
- Four payouts inside the window: 0.20 points. One payout: nothing.
